immutability: These raw snapshots are FROZEN. They are never modified after outcomes are inspected. Any later Yahoo refresh becomes version 2 in a new directory; development data is never silently overwritten with subsequently revised vendor history.
terminology: Yahoo Finance generic/continuous futures series REFERENCING CME equity-index futures. NOT a contract-level CME historical feed.
known: the current Yahoo quote maps to an exchange-listed contract
prices obey the expected tick structure

data_z1/ES_1d.csv.provenance_limitations: generic/continuous series; roll and back-adjustment UNKNOWN
